column1: # Controlled fixture: urn:person/<i>; predicates urn:p (ring/fanout edges), urn:age (i mod 10, explicitly xsd:integer to match SPARQL numeric constants), urn:name (unique), urn:city (i mod 4), urn:nick (none/one/two), rdf:type urn:Person; named graph urn:g mirrors selected p edges. Sizes 0,1,6,64,200 then3000. Compare exact bags with MemoryStore before timing. All nonzero slices below have total projected-key order.

column3: SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { ?s <urn:p> ?o } GROUP BY ?s HAVING(COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT ?type ?p (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { ?s a ?type . ?s ?p ?o } GROUP BY ?type ?p
SELECT ?g (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?s <urn:p> ?o } } GROUP BY ?g
SELECT ?count WHERE { { SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { ?s <urn:p> ?o } } UNION { SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { ?s <urn:name> ?o } } }
SELECT ?s ?age WHERE { ?s <urn:age> ?age } ORDER BY DESC(?age) ?s LIMIT 1
SELECT ?s ?age WHERE { ?s <urn:age> ?age } ORDER BY DESC(?age) ?s LIMIT 10
SELECT ?s ?age WHERE { ?s <urn:age> ?age } ORDER BY DESC(?age) ?s OFFSET 1 LIMIT 10
